brief:
Israeli forces conducted military raids across several West Bank governorates early Sunday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operations included raids on homes, arrests of residents, physical assaults, and the deployment of sound bombs and tear gas canisters. Security forces also imposed closures in the targeted areas as part of the sweeping incursions.

The raids spanned multiple Palestinian towns and villages throughout the occupied territory. Residents reported being forcibly removed from homes during the searches, with some subjected to beatings by soldiers. The use of gas and sound weapons marked an intensification in overnight operations that began in the predawn hours and continued into the morning.
